What the record says

  • The Vikings' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is underdog of 3.5 to 6.5 (since 2002): 37-27-1 against the spread, a 57.8% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is road favorite (all time): 94-112-7, 45.6%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is 48 or higher (46-39, 54.1% over) and least often at 42 to 44.5 (47-65-1, 42.0%).
  • All time they have covered 51.4% at home and 48.6% on the road, a 2.8 point edge at home.
